reviewed: cnn/fetch_coco.py full and subset download boundaries
cnn/train.py mosaic, validation isolation, schedule, cache, seed and resume
cnn/metrics.py and cnn/evaluate.py acceptance wording and thresholds
excluded: No COCO archive or image was downloaded
No blind or reserve pixel annotation was opened
No claim that COCO establishes road-domain acceptance

findings.title: A receipt freezes observed local bytes but does not prove official COCO identity
findings.evidence: fetch() accepts any existing non-empty archive destination as reused and records its newly observed SHA-256. Annotation and image members are now checked against that archive, and later dataset receipt binding detects drift, but the first receipt can still bless a pre-existing structurally valid non-official archive.
findings.required_fix: If official identity is a hard gate, pin trusted expected sizes and cryptographic hashes, or require a separately authenticated source manifest, and reject mismatches. Otherwise label the receipt as observed-local provenance rather than verified-official identity.

findings.title: Disk budget is a one-time constant rather than a remaining-work check
findings.evidence: --full checks only that free space is at least 45 GiB at startup. Image ZIP preflight permits up to 40 GiB uncompressed per archive, but extraction does not compare missing-member bytes plus remaining downloads and archives against current free space. A permitted first archive can therefore consume enough space for a later phase to fail with ENOSPC after partial extraction.
findings.required_fix: Before each download and extraction, compute remaining compressed and uncompressed bytes for missing outputs and require a documented safety margin.

verified_controls.evidence: Only the three fixed COCO archive keys and flat numeric train2017/val2017 JPEG keys are accepted.

verified_controls.control: image ZIP path and shape boundary
verified_controls.evidence: All members are preflighted before writes; split, flat 12-digit JPEG name, uniqueness, count, per-member size, and aggregate size are checked.
http.client.HTTPException is now retried, covering IncompleteRead. Content length and resumed start are checked; partial files are retained for safe continuation.
The final receipt uses exclusive open('x'). Existing destination content is not overwritten.

verified_controls.control: annotation extraction atomicity and archive consistency
verified_controls.evidence: Annotation members are written to exclusive .json.extracting siblings, atomically renamed after the ZIP member reaches CRC completion, and existing final files are checked against archive size and CRC.
dataset.py verifies annotation SHA-256, subset image SHA-256, and full archive SHA-256 plus per-image size and CRC before accepting inputs.
The fixed 2x2 no-crop mosaic applies the same 0.5 scale and quadrant offset to positive boxes and ignore boxes.
Validation uses a separately constructed FullFrameDataset with mosaic disabled and shuffle disabled.

Learning rate is set per optimizer step for five warmup epochs then cosine decay; mosaic is disabled for the final 15 epochs. Checkpoint v2 binds protocol, dataset manifest, image content, preprocessing contract, phase, teacher-cache hash, effective batch, optimizer, scaler, and RNG state.
Non-empty resume output requires a matching last.pt and rejects unknown files or future epoch checkpoint overwrite. Legacy, diagnostic, and interrupted checkpoints cannot be exact-resumed.

Validation selects per-class precision-at-least-0.95 thresholds and reports the recall-at-least-0.85 numerical gate, while output remains diagnostic and formal_acceptance is false. COCO is explicitly not road acceptance evidence.

verification_commands.command: offline mocked IncompleteRead and late unsafe ZIP member fixture
verification_commands.result: initially reproduced one-call IncompleteRead escape and partial extraction before late member rejection; both were fixed, then cnn.test_fetch_coco passed

verification_commands.command: offline forged receipt SHA fixture against build_coco_manifest(raw_images=True)
verification_commands.result: pass after fix: rejected with image differs from download receipt

limitations: No live server headers, official archive checksums, archive sizes, or end-to-end full extraction were verified in this review.
torch deterministic algorithms use warn_only=True, so seed/resume evidence is a code-level protocol and not a cross-hardware bit-exact guarantee.
Passing synthetic and unit tests is not accuracy evidence and does not satisfy road-domain dataset or acceptance gates.
